title: Two-urn transfer with conditional switch of transfer direction
text: Urn 1 has 12 red and 23 blue; Urn 2 has 21 red and 7 blue. You perform 6 rounds: in each round, draw one ball from each urn (without replacement within each urn), compare colors; if they match you transfer 3 balls from Urn 1 to Urn 2 uniformly at random from Urn 1’s remaining contents, otherwise transfer 3 balls from Urn 2 to Urn 1. After 6 rounds, you draw 6 balls from Urn 1. Compute the probability of getting exactly 0 red.
